bio: Tang Miu is an independent indie pop artist and musician who has played music since Mathayom 4 and is currently a first-year university student in 2026. He writes, records and produces his own music, turning personal experiences and everyday feelings into songs. Each release is part of an ongoing diary — a record of where he was, what he felt, and how he continues to grow.
shortBio: Independent artist and musician creating intimate indie pop from feelings, memories and everyday stories.
